主要内容: On February 10, 2015, Insperity, Inc. issued a press release announcing its financial and operating results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2014. The press release is included as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. The company's financial results were reported in accordance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The press release provides details on the company's performance for the specified period. The filing includes a signature by Daniel D. Herink, Senior Vice President of Legal, General Counsel and Secretary, on behalf of Insperity, Inc. The report is dated February 10, 2015, and is filed with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission.
